links.comparator_used: Zero-shot LLM answering without retrieval (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Accuracy on 298 scorable ACR 2021 radiation oncology in-training exam questions
links.effect: Gemini-2.0 improved 6.7% (to 79.2%), Llama-3-70b 8.4% (to 75.8%), GPT-4o 5.7% (to 85.6%) with RAG; top reasoning models (GPT-4o1, o3-mini, DeepSeek-R1) had no improvement or detriment with RAG. Gains in clinical, biology and physics domains.
links.tradeoff: RAG workflows and reasoning models incurred higher computational costs.
links.quote: Top scoring reasoning models surpassed graduating resident averages by 17.7%-20% (P < .01), but had no improvement or detriment with RAG.

links.outcome: Aggregate accuracy of majority vote across models
links.effect: Majority voting boosted aggregate accuracy when individual model performance exceeded 50%; no numbers given in the abstract.
links.quote: Majority voting boosted aggregate accuracy when individual model performance exceeded 50%.

design_hint: retrieval grounding (RAG) added to existing LLMs
